title: Normalized closed coefficient map: existence and invertibility
statement: For the finite coefficient datum and closed immersion of lem-coef-finite-closed-shriek, the counit-normalized closed comparison has a unique defining morphism, satisfies its defining equation, and both the ordinary direct-image comparison and this morphism are isomorphisms.
